reason: Chapter 43 'Hydrogen cyanide' of `2007 - LCI chemicals - Althaus.pdf`, the dataset's own cited report. Section 43.5 'System characterization' prints a complete gate-to-gate unit process that the ecoinvent authors did not use: Tab. 43.2 (ammonia, natural gas and sulfuric acid per kg HCN), Tab. 43.3 (natural gas as fuel, and 'A total of 31 MJ is required per kg of HCN'), Tab. 43.4 (dust, SOx, CH4, NOx, CO2 in g per kg), plus the two reaction equations and the co-product statements (0.23 kg hydrogen, 0.34 kg ammonium sulfate, 0.02 kg sodium cyanide per kg HCN). This matches the dataset's own ecoSpold technology field, 'production by reaction of methane with ammonia'. The captioned tables Tab. 43.5 / 43.6 / 43.7 (pp. 439 ff.) are NOT selected: they are the cumulated PlasticsEurope vector of this very dataset - sec. 43.6: 'Due to the fact that the PlasticsEurope dataset is cumulated it was not possible to use the other processes modelled in econvent to obtain a transparent process chain.' p.438 is included only for that quotation.
